summary: Sertindole was removed from the market in Germany and six other countries starting in 1998 because of heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests done on actual people, gave the drug a medium risk score of 64 for liver issues and a high risk score of 73 for heart issues [M]. Additionally, several clinical research studies on the drug were stopped early because researchers could not find or keep enough volunteers to take part [5][6][7].
